claim_text: Reduce the rate of new occupational illnesses each year.
metric_name: Rate of new occupational illnesses; New occupational health illnesses
context_text: Reduce the rate of new occupational illnesses each year.；7.9% decrease in the rate of new occupational illnesses from 2024.；In 2025, we recorded 196 new occupational health illnesses (2024: 225).
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: 正文和绩效表都显示新职业病从225降至196，对应7.9%下降，直接支持该声明。
notes: 证据合并自绩效目标页与职业健康章节。
llm_reason: The claim asserts an annual reduction in the rate of new occupational illnesses. The evidence provides a rate of 7.9% and illness counts of 196 and 225 but lacks temporal labels or comparative context to demonstrate a downward trend. Without data showing a decrease over time or verification of the 'each year' frequency, the decisive assertion of reduction is ungrounded. The evidence substantiates the existence of the metric but not the claimed outcome.
